13.2.6.2 EcuM Fixed Use Case: request a certain ECU state
Scenario: a Basic Software Module needs to keep the ECU alive or needs to exe-
cute operations before the ECU is shut down. For this purpose the Basic Software
Module may request either the state RUN or POST_RUN.
In this case the following rules apply:
[TPS_BSWMDT_04132] Basic Software Module shall keep the ECU alive
(fixed variant) ⌈
Basic Software Module needs to keep the ECU alive or needs to execute opera-
tions before the ECU is shut down.

• EcuM_RequestPOSTRUN [1]
